# Pau / P-Devs Portfolio

> The personal portfolio of Pau, a full-stack web developer in the Philippines.

This site presents Pau's production projects, technical skills, development
services, and professional contact information.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio home](https://pauuu.dev/): Profile, selected projects, skills, and services.
- [Contact Pau](https://pauuu.dev/contact): Professional inquiry form and contact details.
- [Portfolio source code](https://github.com/s4tch001/Portfolio): Public source repository for this website.

## Usage guidance

- Public pages may be crawled to understand, cite, or summarize Pau's work.
- Treat project screenshots and demo records as illustrative portfolio content.
- Do not collect contact form submissions, secrets, environment values, or non-public project data.

## Owner

- [Pau / P-Devs](https://pauuu.dev/): Full-stack web developer and site owner.
